### Observed differences

- In the later window, activity A08 appears in far fewer traces: participation drops from about 33% to 11%, and mean occurrences per trace from 0.33 to 0.11. [OCC001]
- A08's outgoing behaviour changes: before, about 83% of its transitions went to A16; after, only about 20% go to A16, with many other successors appearing. [DIR001]
- A15 now almost always goes to A16 (about 97% vs 82% before) and rarely to A08 (about 1% vs 17%). [DIR002]
- A21 and A22 shift from going to A30 to going to A24/A23: A21→A30 drops from about 51% to 2%, A22→A30 from 48% to 1%, while A24 and A23 shares rise. [DIR003, DIR004]
- A23 and A24 now go almost exclusively to A30 (about 97% and 95%, up from 47% and 51%). [DIR005, DIR006]
- A29 now goes to A21/A22 (about 98% combined) instead of A23/A24 (about 1.5% combined). [DIR007]
- A08 occurs later in traces when it appears (median relative position from 0.22 to 0.43), and its co-occurrence with A15, A16, A29, and A30 drops from about 33% to 11%. [POS001, REL001, REL002, REL005, REL006]
- Lags change consistently: A21→A30 and A22→A30 shift from mostly lag 1 to mostly lag 2; A23→A30 and A24→A30 shift to mostly lag 1; A29→A21 and A29→A22 shift to mostly lag 1, while A29→A23 and A29→A24 shift to mostly lag 2. [LAG005, LAG006, LAG008, LAG010, LAG011, LAG012, LAG013, LAG014]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a structural change in which A08 is largely skipped or moved later, and the routing through A21/A22/A23/A24/A29/A30 becomes more sequential: A29 → A21/A22 → A24/A23 → A30, rather than the earlier pattern where A21/A22/A23/A24 could go directly to A30 and A08 often preceded A16, A29, or A30. This is supported by the consistent successor changes (DIR003–DIR007), the lag shifts (LAG005–LAG014), and the drop in A08 co-occurrence and position shift (OCC001, POS001, REL001–REL006). A competing explanation—that the differences arise from sampling variation in variant frequencies—is unlikely given the large number of consistent items (30 items vs 0.65 expected by chance), though some individual lag items have small support (e.g., LAG003, LAG007, LAG009) and the exact trace order cannot be fully reconstructed from these indicators.
